title: Bobr games — we build games log by log
meta_desc: Bobr games is a tiny indie studio building cozy, clever strategy games for your phone.
hero_p: Bobr games is a tiny indie studio. Like beavers, we build slowly and carefully — cozy, clever strategy games that are easy to start and hard to put down.
dots_desc: Surround your rival's dots on maps with mountains. Pen-and-paper tactics.
next_text: The beavers are already gnawing on it. 🪵
v1_text: We polish every game like a beaver polishes a dam: carefully, log by log.
v2_text: Skill wins. No pay-to-win and no dark patterns — just a good game.
v3_text: Short games for a coffee break, long ones for a rainy evening — even without internet.
game_meta: Dots RPG — the classic pen-and-paper game of dots with maps, mountains and a clever opponent.
game_intro:
The classic game of dots from the back of a school notebook — now with maps, mountains
      and a clever opponent. Surround your rival's dots and conquer the map.
banner_alt: Dots RPG — surround, capture, conquer the map
tagline: Surround your rival's dots on maps with mountains. Pen-and-paper tactics game.
f1: Classic Dots rules — chains in any direction
f2: Play a bot or a friend on one phone
